name: meuhedet_phase3_final_experiment_config
status: FROZEN for the real-data Phase 3 run before any Phase 3 result and before any Phase 2 VALIDATION result was returned; any change needs a new freeze

outcome.label: Fall_Next_180D_Ind
outcome.note: Fall_Next_180D_Ind - EXPLORATORY 180-DAY OUTCOME, NOT EFALLS REPRODUCTION

time_contract.name: meuhedet_phase3_time_contract
time_contract.outcome_window: Index_Date + 1 day .. Label_End_180D (= Index_Date + 180 days); events ON Index_Date are NOT outcome events

attestation.source: the DWH developer who built V_Falls_Prediction_Wide_1 (verbal explanation reported by the project lead, 2026-09-30)
statements: clinical predictors include information available through the END of 2025-01-01
the 180-day fall outcome EXCLUDES falls on 2025-01-01; the outcome window starts on 2025-01-02
the extraction does not include clinical events dated after Index_Date
attestation.status: PROVISIONAL until the checks below pass on the real extract; to be confirmed in writing by the DWH team (open question Q-P3-01)

V1_label_excludes_index_day.text: no positive 180-day label has its first event on or before Index_Date (Next_Fall_Date_180D > Index_Date, Days_To_Next_Fall_180D >= 1)

V2_window_end.text: Label_End_180D - Index_Date = 180 days on every labelled row

V3_no_post_index_records.text: no record date of a predictor source is after Index_Date; if violated, the rows are UNKNOWN (bounded) and the attestation for sources WITHOUT a row-level date is withdrawn (they fall back to UNRESOLVED / exploratory)

V4_days_since_consistency.text: Days_Since_* = Index_Date - its date, >= 0, wherever both exist

V5_index_day_fall_vs_label.text: cross-tabulation Fall_On_Index_Date_Ind x label (an index-day fall is predictor-time history, not an outcome)

V7_proxy_episode_audit.text: TRAIN only: Last_Fall_Date / Days_Since_Last_Fall / Index_Date / Next_Fall_Date_180D - consistency, gap between the last and the next fall, early-event concentration among recent fallers (see proxy_audit)

V8_availability_indicators.text: data-quality signals of delayed availability: Unsettled_Visit_Counter_Ind, Future_Dated_365D, Fallback_Exposure_365D, External_Care_Hidden_By_Billing_Lag_365D (aggregate)

V9_cohort_reconciliation.text: FULL_LABELED = D00_CLEAN + the D-00 rows, and the D-00 rows = the rows the reference build removed (n_rows_timing_violation)

V6_boundary_episode.text: TRAIN only: recorded events on day +1 among patients with an index-day fall / diagnosis / visit record vs others (one episode crossing midnight could be counted twice)

availability.general_assumption: A-AVAIL-1: a record dated on or before Index_Date was present in the operational system by the end of Index_Date (no late entry); not verifiable from the extract (no entry timestamps)

FALL_EVENTS.assumption: fall / fracture events are dated by the encounter; hospital / ED events may be coded after the encounter (coding lag)

DIAGNOSES.assumption: diagnoses are recorded at the visit; retrospective coding would move information after Index_Date

VISITS.assumption: visits are recorded in real time; counters inside the 3-day settlement period can still change (Unsettled_Visit_Counter_Ind, V8)

NURSE_FALLS_RISK_999_52.assumption: nurse forms dated by the assessment; forms completed / signed later would be unavailable at prediction time

NURSE_ASSESSMENT_SUMMARY.assumption: aggregates of the nurse forms above

MEFI.assumption: the MEFI group is a periodically computed index; the group valid at Index_Date is assumed to have been computed by then (the batch schedule is undocumented)

PRESCRIPTIONS.assumption: prescriptions written / purchased are recorded by the EHR / pharmacy systems at the transaction

LABS.assumption: referrals are recorded at the visit; 'performed' may be imported from laboratory systems with a delay of days

MEDICATION_EXPOSURE.assumption: active exposure at Index_Date is derived from dispensings dated on/before Index_Date; assumed exposure windows (Fallback_Exposure_365D) and future-dated prescriptions (Future_Dated_365D) are data-quality signals (V8)

REGISTRIES.assumption: 'active at Index_Date' is evaluated on the registry table; memberships can be created after clinical review with an earlier start date (backdating) - an event dated before Index_Date may have been entered after it

COMORBIDITY_SOCIAL.assumption: the comorbidity group / benefit status: construction date and window undocumented (may be computed at extraction time)

EXTERNAL_CARE_INVOICES.assumption: only the visible (already billed at Index_Date) count is used; the billing-lag totals are forbidden

Bought_Outside_Meuhedet_365D.assumption: purchases outside Meuhedet reach the HMO through reimbursement claims submitted later

Income_Support.assumption: administrative benefit status as of Index_Date; retroactive updates possible

HMO_Seniority_Months.assumption: membership length from the member master

External_Care_Count_365D_Visible.assumption: documented as already billed at Index_Date

excluded_date_sources.EXTERNAL_CARE_INVOICES: billing lag: totals include records billed after Index_Date (forbidden)

documented_as_of_columns.External_Care_Count_365D_Visible: external-care records already billed at Index_Date (as-of correct, data dictionary DOCUMENTED)

reclassifiable_not_used.Fall_On_Index_Date_Ind: an index-day fall is predictor-time history under this contract; its information is already carried by Days_Since_Last_Fall = 0 (fall recency features); a dedicated feature needs a contract change reviewed first

partitions.TRAIN: every recovery gate, screening, tuning, selection, stability, ablation; the primary internal estimate (outer OOF)
partitions.VALIDATION: REUSED: sealed until SELECTION_FROZEN.json; one-shot descriptive check; never selects, tunes or recalibrates
partitions.TEST: dropped in memory right after the reference split hash check (and TEST-assigned D-00 rows likewise); never read

FALL_EVENTS.text: fall/fracture event counts in sliding windows, a since-2022 cumulative flag/count and the latest event date

DIAGNOSES.text: diagnosis counts in sliding windows, a since-2022 cumulative 719.7 flag and the latest diagnosis date

VISITS.text: visit counts in sliding windows and the latest visit date

NURSE_FALLS_RISK_999_52.text: items of the latest falls-risk form and its date (earlier forms are overwritten in the extract)

NURSE_GET_UP_AND_GO_999_79.text: items of the latest get-up-and-go form and its date

NURSE_FUNCTION_999_175.text: scores of the latest function / mobility / senses form and its date

NURSE_COGNITION.text: latest Mini-Cog score and its date (MMSE empty per S2T)

NURSE_HOME_SAFETY_999_139.text: answers of the latest home-safety questionnaire and its date

NURSE_ASSESSMENT_SUMMARY.text: nurse-assessment counts in 365 days and the latest assessment date (all forms)

MEFI.text: current MEFI group and the start date of that group (a same-group reassessment does not move the date)

EXTERNAL_CARE_INVOICES.text: invoice-based counts; billing lag means records can appear after the index day

REGISTRIES.text: registry flags active at the index date; only the first entry date of any registry exists (not recoverable row by row)

PRESCRIPTIONS.text: prescription counts in 365 days, no record date (not recoverable)

LABS.text: laboratory counts in 365 days, no record date (not recoverable)

MEDICATION_EXPOSURE.text: active-exposure substance counts at the index date, no dispensing date (not recoverable)

COMORBIDITY_SOCIAL.text: comorbidity index / benefit status, no record date (not recoverable)

not_bounded_by_record_date.Days_Since_MEFI_Assessment: MEFI_From_Date is the start of the CURRENT GROUP; a same-group reassessment on/after the index day changes this value without moving the date
not_bounded_by_record_date.MEFI_Assessment_Count: a reassessment on/after the index day can increase the count without changing the group start date (MEFI_From_Date)

remediation.COMPLETE_RECORD_DATE: compute every window / latest-record value with Event_Date <= Index_Date and NEVER include a record dated after Index_Date; keep the latest record ON OR BEFORE Index_Date per member and form (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member, form ORDER BY record_date DESC) WHERE record_date <= Index_Date)
remediation.SUFFICIENT_ONLY_RECORD_DATE: add the start date of EACH registry membership (Registry_<X>_Start_Date) so that 'active at Index_Date' can be verified row by row
remediation.NO_RECORD_DATE: expose the latest contributing record date (dispensing / prescription / laboratory / index computation date) so that availability at Index_Date can be verified row by row instead of attested
remediation.NOT_BOUNDED: expose the date of the latest assessment behind the value (e.g. MEFI_Last_Assessment_Date) and compute counts with Assessment_Date <= Index_Date
remediation.POST_INDEX: never a predictor; no correction makes post-index information available at the prediction time

recovery.row_recoverable_evidence_kind: COMPLETE_RECORD_DATE with a DOCUMENTED record date

classes.SAFE_VERIFIED: row-level record dates (or documented static attribute): available at prediction time on every analysed row
classes.SAFE_VERIFIED_BOUNDED: row-level record dates; a few rows carry a post-index record: they stay in the population and are evaluated with bounds
classes.SAFE_ATTESTED: no row-level record date: eligible on the DWH statement 'no event after Index_Date' confirmed by check V3 (not row-verified)
classes.NOT_RECOVERABLE_FUTURE_RECORDS: too many rows with post-index records (gates G2 / G3): DWH correction needed
classes.UNRESOLVED: timing cannot be supported (unknown contract timing, a post-index date source, or the attestation withdrawn): exploratory only
classes.NOT_RECOVERABLE_FORBIDDEN: post-index / label / forbidden information: never a predictor
classes.INELIGIBLE_DATA: fewer than the minimum KNOWN observed TRAIN rows, or constant: not analysable

recovery.known_unknown_rule:
KNOWN    the value was available at prediction time: a documented static attribute; or the source's record date is ON OR BEFORE Index_Date;
             or the source has no record and no value was recorded
    UNKNOWN  a record of the source is dated AFTER Index_Date (genuine future information, if the extract holds any), a value was recorded
             without its record date, or a cell could not be read (e.g. '00:00.0')
Per feature (classes):
    SAFE_VERIFIED           every input has a row-level record date (or is a documented static attribute) and every analysed row is KNOWN
    SAFE_VERIFIED_BOUNDED   as above with a few UNKNOWN rows (within the gates): those rows stay in the population and are evaluated with bounds
    SAFE_ATTESTED           an input has no row-level date (medications, prescriptions, laboratories, registries, comorbidity / social status,
                            undocumented static meanings, values the date does not bound): eligible because the DWH states that no event after
                            Index_Date enters the extract AND check V3 found no post-index record in any dated source; withdrawn otherwise
    NOT_RECOVERABLE_FUTURE_RECORDS  too many rows carry post-index records (gates G2 / G3)
    UNRESOLVED              timing cannot be supported (unknown contract timing, a documented post-index date source, or the attestation withdrawn)
    NOT_RECOVERABLE_FORBIDDEN       post-index / label / forbidden information: never a predictor
    INELIGIBLE_DATA         fewer than the minimum KNOWN observed TRAIN rows, or constant

bounds.method: partial identification over the observed pre-index states of the fitting rows, cumulative upper bounds applied
bounds.xgboost: sound outer bound (interval propagation through every tree)
bounds.fit_rows: rows whose every scope feature is KNOWN
bounds.adverse: events lowest, non-events highest possible risk
bounds.comparison: adverse difference = new adverse - reference favourable

feasibility.rule: GO when the time contract passes its hard checks (V1, V2) and at least one priority domain holds a NEWLY eligible non-indicator feature (not eligible under the Phase 2 rule, eligible under PRIMARY_FULL) meeting both adequacy minima; otherwise NO_GO (Outcome B: DWH remediation, no model is fitted)
